assets.title: A harmonised dataset for Earth system foundation models (WorldTensor)
assets.description: A preprint presenting WorldTensor, a harmonised global dataset aligning hundreds of environmental and socioeconomic variables to a standardised 0.25 degree grid and annual temporal framework. It integrates reanalysis, remote sensing, emissions inventories, land use, hydrology, infrastructure, hazard and socioeconomic data to support multimodal Earth system foundation models.
assets.notes: Context: "Cube" for earth system foundational models
organisations: Politecnico di Milano (Department of Management, Economics and Industrial Engineering)
RFF-CMCC European Institute on Economics and the Environment
CMCC Foundation - Euro-Mediterranean Center on Climate Change

lead_contact.name: Carlos Rodriguez-Pardo
lead_contact.affiliation: Politecnico di Milano; RFF-CMCC European Institute on Economics and the Environment

assets.title: AgDataHub Mali
assets.description: A country data hub for Mali presenting weather forecasts (short, medium and seasonal range), rainfall (CHIRPS, TAMSAT, ARC2), agriculture (FAO area/production/yield), soils (ISRIC) and satellite imagery including the Agricultural Stress Index. Combines forecast, current and historic climate and crop data for decision support.
assets.spatial_resolution: Mixed (e.g. ARC2 0.1 degree; GAUL2 admin regions)
assets.notes: AICCRA DataHub (Mali) - ILRI
organisations: AICCRA (Accelerating Impacts of CGIAR Climate Research for Africa)

assets.title: AgMRV Knowledge Portal
assets.description: A gateway to guidance, methodologies, case studies, databases and software for the measurement, reporting and verification (MRV) of greenhouse gas emissions and mitigation in agriculture. It covers livestock, rice and agroforestry, with sections on MRV in Practice, a Resource Library, and Software & Tools.
organisations: Global Research Alliance on Agricultural Greenhouse Gases (GRA)
CGIAR Research Program on Climate Change, Agriculture and Food Security (CCAFS)

assets.title: AGRA Climate Vulnerability Assessment Tool (ClimVAT)
assets.source: AGRA (Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa)
assets.description: A digital climate vulnerability assessment platform that combines satellite-derived climate data, soil information and socio-economic indicators to generate high-resolution maps of climate risk at national and sub-county levels. The hazard-change view maps projected changes in climate hazards affecting farmers.
assets.notes: AGRA climate vulnerability assessment
organisations: AGRA (Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa)

assets.title: AICCRA Collection on CGSpace
assets.description: A dedicated collection in CGIAR's CGSpace repository holding reports, management plans and research outputs from the Accelerating Impacts of CGIAR Climate Research for Africa (AICCRA) project, which scales climate-smart agriculture and climate information services across anchor countries in Africa.
assets.notes: AICCRA collection on CGSpace
organisations: AICCRA (Accelerating Impacts of CGIAR Climate Research for Africa)

assets.title: Atlas of Climate Adaptation in South Asian Agriculture (ACASA)
assets.source: Borlaug Institute for South Asia (BISA) / CIMMYT
assets.description: A web-enabled atlas integrating high-resolution climate data, crop modelling and expert-validated adaptation practices for South Asian agriculture, covering 15 crops and six livestock species. It maps climate hazards, exposure and vulnerability of smallholder populations and farms, and evidence on adaptation interventions.
assets.notes: ACASA (Atlas of Climate Adaptation in South Asian Agriculture) - BISA

assets.title: Climate Analytics Tools
assets.description: A portal of open-access analytical tools for policymakers and researchers, including the Climate Action Tracker, Climate Impact Explorer, Climate Risk Dashboard and 1.5C National Pathway Explorer. Resources are filterable by region and topics such as adaptation, climate finance, impacts and risks, and decarbonisation targets.

assets.title: Climate Engine
assets.source: Desert Research Institute and University of Idaho (with NIDIS and Google)
assets.description: A no-code web application using Google Earth Engine to process, visualise, download and share climate and remote sensing data on demand. Includes satellite observations (e.g. Landsat), climate reanalyses (e.g. ERA5) and decision-ready drought and rangeland vegetation datasets.
assets.notes: ClimateEngine.org

assets.title: Climate Impact Lab
assets.description: A nonprofit research collaboration (UC Berkeley, EPIC-University of Chicago, Rhodium Group, Rutgers) that quantifies the real-world impacts of climate change sector-by-sector and location-by-location, covering mortality, labour, agriculture, conflict, infrastructure and energy demand. Data are published openly under CC BY 4.0 and via the Human Climate Horizons and Impact Map tools.
assets.notes: Climate Impact Lab
organisations: University of Chicago (Energy Policy Institute, EPIC)

assets.title: Climate Project Explorer
assets.source: Multilateral Climate Funds (Adaptation Fund, CIFs, GEF, GCF); powered by Climate Policy Radar
assets.description: An AI-powered tool, launched at COP29, for searching and discovering climate projects and programmes funded by the four Multilateral Climate Funds. It allows users to explore projects and policies by country and theme across more than 130 countries.

assets.title: DeadTrees.Earth
assets.description: An online platform mapping tree mortality and forest die-off from remote sensing and deep learning. Detailed content could not be retrieved.
assets.notes: description from URL/title only (fetch failed)

assets.title: Destination Earth Data Hub (Earth Data Hub)
assets.description: A gateway providing pre-processed, analysis-ready Earth data optimised for cloud computing. Its catalogue includes the Climate Change Adaptation Digital Twin (Climate DT) at km-scale (5-10 km) resolution and ERA5 reanalysis collections, accessed via a personal access token.
assets.notes: Destination Earth Data Hub
organisations: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF)

assets.title: Destination Earth VizLab
assets.description: An interactive visualisation service for exploring complex Earth system datasets in a dynamic 3D/4D environment, drawing on DestinE services and Copernicus data. It supports maps, streamlines (directional data such as wind/currents) and volumetric assets.
assets.notes: Destination Earth VizLab

assets.title: Digital Earth Africa (Registry of Open Data on AWS)
assets.description: A collaboration collection on the Registry of Open Data on AWS providing free and open access to DE Africa's decision-ready Earth observation products for the continent, including Landsat Collection 2, CHIRPS rainfall, fractional cover, waterbodies and water observations from space. Data are available under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence.
assets.notes: Digital Earth Africa

assets.title: Digital Gender Gaps Dashboard
assets.source: University of Oxford (Leverhulme Centre for Demographic Science) and Saarland University
assets.description: An interactive dashboard providing estimates of gender gaps and gender-specific adoption of internet use and mobile phone ownership, derived from Facebook Marketing API data combined with population and development indicators. Estimates cover 215 countries at national level and 117 low- and middle-income countries at first administrative level.
assets.spatial_resolution: National and first sub-national administrative level
organisations: University of Oxford (Leverhulme Centre for Demographic Science)

assets.title: Ecosystem Integrity Index
assets.description: An online platform presenting the Ecosystem Integrity Index, a global measure of the condition of terrestrial ecosystems across structure, composition and function. Detailed content could not be retrieved.
assets.notes: description from URL/title only (fetch failed)

assets.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Geospatial Platform
assets.source: FAO (Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations)
assets.description: A geospatial data platform hosting over a million geospatial layers and thousands of statistics series across more than ten domains linked to food and agriculture, including food security, crops, soil, land, water, climate, fisheries, livestock and forestry. Data are sourced from FAO and other UN, NGO, academic, private-sector and space-agency providers.
assets.notes: FAO Hand-in-Hand geospatial platform / data catalog
organisations: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

assets.title: Food Systems Dashboard FSCI Indicators
assets.source: Food Systems Dashboard (GAIN and Johns Hopkins University) / Food Systems Countdown Initiative
assets.description: A section of the Food Systems Dashboard presenting the Food Systems Countdown Initiative (FSCI) indicators, a framework of around 50 indicators across five themes: diets/nutrition/health; environment, natural resources and production; livelihoods, poverty and equity; governance; and resilience. It supports annual monitoring of global food systems.
assets.notes: Food Systems Dashboard FSCI indicators

assets.title: Global Nature Watch
assets.source: World Resources Institute (Land & Carbon Lab / Global Forest Watch), Development Seed
assets.description: An open, AI-powered platform with a chat-style interface that integrates 80+ peer-reviewed datasets from Global Forest Watch and Land & Carbon Lab. Users ask plain-language questions to explore change across forests, grasslands, wetlands, croplands, pastures and carbon fluxes via maps and statistics.

assets.title: Nature-Positive Agrifood Systems Toolkit
assets.source: WWF (with Climate Focus, FAO, Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT, and NDC Partnership)
assets.description: An interactive online platform curating tools and case studies to help policymakers and practitioners design and implement food systems strategies that benefit people, nature and climate. The 2025 edition supports NDC, NAP and NBSAP implementation in agrifood systems.
assets.notes: WWF agrifood systems toolkit
organisations: Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT

assets.title: Naturebase
assets.description: A free interactive platform bringing together science-based data on natural climate solutions, showing where, why and how to implement high-integrity nature-based interventions with the greatest carbon mitigation, biodiversity and human wellbeing benefits. The beta version includes data for 18 of 25 natural climate solutions pathways.

assets.title: UN-SPIDER Data Sources
assets.source: UN-SPIDER (United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs)
assets.description: A curated database linking to sources of satellite imagery, elevation models, land use/land cover maps and near real-time data products for different hazard types. Searchable by data type, hazard, disaster management phase, cost, temporal or spatial coverage, sensor and file type.
assets.notes: UN-SPIDER data sources
organisations: United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs (UNOOSA)

assets.title: UNFCCC Greenhouse Gas Data Interface
assets.description: The official interface providing access to greenhouse gas data reported by Parties to the Climate Change Convention, from Annex I annual GHG inventory submissions and non-Annex I national communications and biennial update reports. Data are presented in tabular and graphical form and many tables are downloadable as Excel spreadsheets.

assets.title: WFP VAM HumanitarianDataCube STAC Catalogue
assets.source: World Food Programme (WFP) VAM - Vulnerability Analysis and Mapping
assets.description: A SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog (STAC) browser exposing WFP VAM's HumanitarianDataCube of Earth observation data. Provides programmatic and browser-based discovery of geospatial climate and hazard datasets used for food security and vulnerability analysis.
assets.notes: WFP VAM STAC catalogue; STAC browser requires JavaScript

assets.title: What climate-smart agriculture means for smallholder farmers
assets.description: A report analysing the exposure of smallholder farmers to climate hazards such as drought, flooding and extreme heat across India, Ethiopia and Mexico, and identifying 33 climate adaptation and mitigation measures. It examines feasibility of adoption and the implications for food security and emissions.

assets.title: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal
assets.description: A free online hub for climate-related data, projections and tools providing historical and future climate, vulnerability and impact information for 196 countries and territories. It includes climate, disaster risk and socio-economic datasets plus synthesis products such as Climate Risk Country Profiles, at national, sub-national and watershed scales.

assets.title: World Bank Data360 Climate Atlas
assets.description: A curated atlas within the World Bank Data360 platform focused on exposure, vulnerability and adaptation to climate hazards. It measures the population living in areas affected by a given climate-related hazard (using a 100-year return period) across more than 200 economies.
assets.notes: World Bank Data360 climate atlas; platform in beta

assets.title: WRI Global Dashboard Model Drivers of Forest Loss 1km
assets.source: World Resources Institute (WRI) / Google Earth Engine
assets.description: A Google Earth Engine dataset mapping the dominant drivers of forest loss at 1km resolution, produced by WRI's Global Dashboard Model. It classifies forest loss into categories such as commodity-driven deforestation, agriculture, forestry, wildfire and urbanisation.
assets.notes: WRI drivers of forest loss 1km on GEE; description from URL/title only (fetch failed)

assets.title: Adaptation Finance Power BI Dashboard
assets.description: A Power BI dashboard on adaptation finance. Interactive visualisation of adaptation finance data relevant to climate adaptation planning.
assets.notes: Labelled 'Finance' (adaptation finance PowerBI dashboard). Not fetched (Power BI login/embed); description from URL/title only. Built with Power BI (publish-to-web).

assets.title: Climate Resilience Platform
assets.source: Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT
assets.description: A free, open-source online tool providing climate risk and opportunity intelligence for agricultural supply-chain planning, combining crop-specific yield responses with climate hazards (drought, flood, heat, frost) to guide where and how to invest in climate-resilient agriculture. Used with the complementary ACLIMATAR adaptation tool.
assets.notes: Fetch timed out; details from search. Adopted by networks representing 400+ companies.
organisations: Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT

assets.title: Global Adaptation Mapping Initiative (GAMI)
assets.description: An international collaborative initiative that systematically maps and codes documented human adaptation responses to climate change from the scientific and grey literature (over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles coded by 100+ researchers). The database informed the IPCC AR6 process and is publicly accessible for further research.
assets.notes: Fetch timed out; details from search. Data free of charge subject to terms and conditions.

assets.description: Nature article (2025) assessing the impacts of climate change on global agricultural production while accounting for farmer adaptation.
assets.notes: Cross-listed: assets:Hazard & Impacts, methods:LLMs

assets.title: UNFCCC Adaptation Committee Interactive Portal on the State of Adaptation
assets.description: A UNFCCC Adaptation Committee interactive portal where developing country Parties present their National Adaptation Plans, highlighting climate risks and adaptation actions. Central reference for national adaptation efforts.
assets.notes: Fetch timed out; details from search.

assets.title: Annual global gridded livestock mapping from 1961 to 2021
assets.description: First annual gridded livestock-of-the-world dataset at 5 km resolution for eight groups (cattle, buffaloes, sheep, goats, horses, pigs, chickens, ducks), produced by a Random Forest workflow constrained by FAOSTAT, with per-pixel per-year uncertainty layers. Useful for livestock distribution, food security and emissions analyses.
assets.notes: Insight article: global-livestock-dynamics. Published: ESSD 17, 5543-5556 (2025).

assets.title: Satellite-based high-resolution maps of cocoa planted area for Côte d'Ivoire and Ghana
assets.description: Deep-learning maps of cocoa planted area for Côte d'Ivoire and Ghana from satellite imagery, validated in situ. Finds cocoa drives >37% and 13% of protected-area forest loss respectively, and that official reports underestimate planted area by up to 40% (Ghana).
assets.notes: Kalischek, Lang, Renier, ... Wegner (arXiv:2206.06119, CC-BY-4.0). Underlying map data available via ETH.

assets.title: CROPGRIDS: a global geo-referenced dataset of 173 crops
assets.description: A comprehensive global geo-referenced dataset providing harvested and physical area information for 173 crops for reference year 2020 at 0.05 degree resolution. Updates the widely used Monfreda et al. (2008) dataset using published gridded datasets, subnational data and FAOSTAT statistics.
assets.notes: Fetch timed out; details from search. Scientific Data is an open-access journal.

assets.title: Dry Matter Productivity 1999-2020 (raster 1 km), global, 10-daily – version 2
assets.description: Global 10-daily dry matter productivity (vegetation biomass growth rate, related to net primary productivity) in kg gross dry matter per hectare per day, tailored for agro-statistical use. Supports vegetation and crop growth monitoring.

assets.title: Global Livestock Dynamics
assets.description: A Land & Carbon Lab insights article on global livestock dynamics, drawing on annual gridded livestock mapping (by species: cattle, buffaloes, sheep, goats, pigs, poultry). Useful context for livestock distribution, grazing pressure and related emissions.
assets.notes: Fetch timed out; details from search. Underlying dataset published in ESSD (Copernicus). Related dataset: annual-global-gridded-livestock-mapping-1961-2021.
organisations: International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA)

assets.title: Global Pasture Watch
assets.description: A research consortium led by Land & Carbon Lab producing recurrent global maps of grassland class and extent, vegetation height, gross primary productivity and livestock headcount from 2000 onwards, built with spatiotemporal machine learning on Earth observation data. Six v1 products are published in the Google Earth Engine catalogue — annual dominant grassland class, cultivated and natural/semi-natural grassland probabilities, short vegetation height and uncalibrated GPP at 30 m, plus FAOSTAT-adjusted livestock headcount at 1 km.
assets.spatial_resolution: 30 m (grassland class, vegetation height, uGPP); 1 km (livestock headcount)
assets.temporal_coverage: 2000-2022 annual; vegetation height and uGPP 2000 onwards
assets.notes: Earth Engine assets live under the projects/global-pasture-watch/assets/ prefix; the grassland class and extent product is documented in Parente et al. (2024), Scientific Data, with the data archived on Zenodo. CC-BY-4.0 is stated on the Earth Engine catalogue entries themselves, so the whole v1 series is reusable with attribution. Distinct from Global Nature Watch despite the similar name.
organisations: International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA)
German Centre for Integrative Biodiversity Research (iDiv)

assets.title: Global spatially explicit crop water consumption shows an overall increase of 9% for 46 agricultural crops from 2010 to 2020
assets.description: Global spatially explicit estimates of blue and green crop water consumption for 46 crops, reporting a 9% overall increase from 2010 to 2020, with Asia accounting for the largest share. Useful for irrigation and agricultural water-use analysis.

lead_contact.name: Davy Vanham
lead_contact.affiliation: International Water Management Institute (IWMI), Colombo, Sri Lanka

assets.title: HarvestStat Africa – Harmonized Subnational Crop Statistics for Sub-Saharan Africa
assets.description: Harmonized subnational crop statistics for Sub-Saharan Africa with ~574,204 records covering quantity produced, harvested area and yield. Provides a consistent long-term baseline for agricultural production and yield analysis.
organisations: German Centre for Integrative Biodiversity Research (iDiv)

assets.title: Sample Earth
assets.description: An open, machine-learning-ready global land-cover reference dataset of GPS-located, quality-controlled sample points to train and validate AI land-cover maps, with a focus on coffee and cocoa smallholder production systems. Uses 10 main classes and 68 sub-classes, combining expert interpretation of high-resolution imagery with ground-truth observations.
assets.notes: Fetch timed out; details from search. Also catalogued on CGSpace/CGIAR.
organisations: Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT (Terra-i)

assets.title: An Africa-wide agricultural production database to support policy and satellite-based measurement systems
assets.description: Data descriptor for GROW-Africa, a database of 535,844 georeferenced crop-yield observations across Africa spanning 1960-2023 (the vast majority 2000-2023). Supports analysis of historical yield trends and training of algorithms to estimate crop yields from Earth-observation satellite data.

assets.title: Spatial frameworks for robust estimation of yield gaps
assets.description: Methodological paper on spatial frameworks for robustly estimating crop yield gaps (the difference between potential and actual yields). Relevant to productivity-gap and food-security analysis.

lead_contact.affiliation: Department of Agronomy and Horticulture, University of Nebraska-Lincoln, USA

assets.title: Terra-i+
assets.source: Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT (Terra-i)
assets.description: A satellite-based monitoring platform for agroforestry supply-chain sustainability, providing high-resolution deforestation detection (10 m, Sentinel-1, updated every 12 days), crop-specific land cover, shade-tree/carbon-stock and coffee climate-suitability maps. Supports EU Deforestation Regulation compliance and carbon-sequestration assessment.
assets.temporal_coverage: Robusta coffee suitability to 2030; deforestation updated every 12 days
assets.notes: Vietnam coffee map; dashboard login demo/demo. Future expansion planned to major coffee/cocoa regions (Guatemala, Brazil, Cameroon, Colombia, Ethiopia, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Kenya, etc.).

assets.description: Interactive sandbox tool for enhanced rock weathering (ERW) carbon dioxide removal, examining false-positive rates in ERW measurement and verification. Relevant to monitoring soil-based CDR on croplands.

assets.title: FAO GHG Drained Organic Soils Emissions (Annual)
assets.description: FAOSTAT estimates of CO2 and N2O greenhouse-gas emissions from drained organic (histosol) soils under cropland and grassland, computed in Google Earth Engine using IPCC Tier I methods with annual land-cover maps. Emission layers reported in tonnes/hectare.

assets.title: Meta / WRI Global Canopy Height Map (1 m)
assets.description: Google Earth Engine app viewing the Meta and WRI global tree canopy height map at 1 m resolution, derived with machine learning from Maxar satellite imagery (2009-2020), enabling detection of individual trees and forest carbon accounting worldwide.
assets.notes: Meta canopy height map

assets.title: OpenLandMap-soilDB global 30 metre soil datacube
assets.description: Google Earth Engine web viewer for the OpenLandMap-soilDB global soil datacube, providing dynamic predictions of soil organic carbon, bulk density, pH, texture fractions and USDA soil types at 30 m resolution based on spatiotemporal machine learning. Registered under a CC-BY licence.

assets.title: openlandmap/soildb (GitHub)
assets.description: Code repository for producing global soil-property predictions using scikit-map, underpinning the OpenLandMap-soilDB 30 m soil datacube derived from harmonised legacy soil samples and remote sensing via tree-based quantile regression random forests.

assets.title: Reducing Emissions from Fertilizers: Opportunities and Challenges
assets.description: Review chapter (Sapkota, Singh & Mukherji) on strategies to cut greenhouse gas emissions from fertilizer production and use, covering nitrogen use efficiency and green ammonia. Mineral fertilizers contribute up to ~5% of global GHG emissions.
assets.notes: Review: Reducing emissions from fertilizers: Opportunities and challenges. Open-access version available on CGSpace.

assets.title: A high-resolution database of historical and future climate for Africa developed with deep neural networks
assets.description: Data descriptor for ClimateAF, an interpolated climate database for Africa covering monthly, annual, decadal and 30-year normals from 1901 to present plus multi-model CMIP6 21st-century projections, built with thin-plate-spline interpolation, deep-learning orographic precipitation modelling and lapse-rate downscaling. Includes the ClimateAF software package and ~1 km gridded downloads.
assets.spatial_resolution: ~250 m temperature / ~2.5 km precipitation; also 30 arcsec (~1 km) gridded
assets.notes: ClimateAF; contact Andreas Hamann (andreas.hamann@ualberta.ca); alternative access http://tinyurl.com/ClimateAF; lead author Colin R. Mahony.

assets.title: BuildForward Explorer
assets.description: Interactive explorer for BuildForward's engineering-grade climate data for infrastructure design, providing site-specific current and future design values such as temperature extremes, wind speeds, precipitation intensities, heating/cooling degree days and solar radiation.
assets.notes: BuildForward explorer; commercial product, likely requires account.

assets.title: BuildForward Precipitation Methodology
assets.description: Methodology document describing how BuildForward derives climate-informed precipitation design values, including rainfall intensity-duration-frequency curves for stormwater, drainage and flood-risk assessment, calibrated to quality-controlled weather-station observations.
assets.notes: BuildForward precip methodology.

assets.title: BURGER - A bottom-up regionalization approach for global sub-daily intensity-duration-frequency data
assets.description: Dataset providing globally consistent sub-daily rainfall intensity-duration-frequency (IDF) maps, produced by combining Global Sub-Daily Rainfall gauge observations with a random-forest bottom-up regionalization approach.
assets.notes: Record page public but files restricted (login/request); CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Merged with the Water Resources Research paper entry (Hoch et al., 2025).

assets.title: CHELSA (Climatologies at High Resolution for the Earth's Land Surface Areas)
assets.source: WSL (Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research)
assets.description: Global high-resolution climate dataset providing temperature and precipitation climatologies plus 19 bioclimatic variables, produced by mechanistic downscaling of ERA reanalysis that accounts for terrain, wind fields and orographic effects. Matching CMIP6 future projections are also available.
assets.notes: CHELSA high-res climate data.
organisations: Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research (WSL)

assets.title: CRA5 Compressed ERA5 Dataset and Compression Models
assets.description: Repository distributing the CRA5 dataset, an extreme (>300x) compression of the ERA5 reanalysis from 400+ TB to under 1 TB using a VAEformer variational transformer, together with pre-trained auto-encoder and forecasting models. Weather models trained on CRA5 match those trained on full ERA5.
assets.notes: CRA5 reanalysis; dataset also mirrored on Hugging Face (taohan10200/CRA5-Dataset). Companion to Scientific Data paper s41597-026-07381-2.
organisations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

assets.title: CRA5: a high-fidelity compressed reanalysis atmospheric dataset for weather and climate research
assets.description: Data descriptor introducing CRA5, a deep-learning-compressed version of the ERA5 reanalysis that reduces a 400+ TB dataset to under 1 TB using a variational transformer (VAEformer) while retaining scientific utility. Authored by Tao Han, Dazhao Du, Zhenghao Chen, Song Guo, Wanli Ouyang and Lei Bai.
assets.notes: Companion paper to the CRA5 GitHub repository (taohan10200/CRA5); article listed as in-press/pre-edited at time of cataloguing.
organisations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

assets.description: Open-source web application and Python API (ClimateSERVpy) to visualise and download historical rainfall and vegetation-condition data (CHIRPS, IMERG, eMODIS NDVI/ESI) plus 180-day rainfall and temperature forecasts, to support agriculture and water-availability decisions.
assets.notes: SERVIR (joint NASA/USAID). Maintainer Billy Ashmall (NASA/USRA); science team incl. Ashutosh Limaye, Eric Anderson, Brent Roberts (NASA). Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.11550665.

assets.title: A global 1 km gridded dataset of household consumption expenditure in purchasing power parity 2013-2024
assets.description: A global 1 km gridded dataset of household and NPISH final consumption expenditure in purchasing-power-parity (constant 2021 international dollars), 2013-2024. Disaggregates World Bank economy-level totals using nighttime lights, population, built-up surface, roads and POIs in a stacked Super Learner framework; released as observed-only and regionally completed variants with per-capita, cell-total and QA rasters. Aimed at welfare geography, market access and SDG analyses (poverty, equity).
assets.notes: Nature Scientific Data data descriptor (early-access), DOI 10.1038/s41597-026-07919-4. First author Run Shi (Guangdong Academy of Sciences); corresponding author Yuanzheng Cui. Open access but CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (no derivatives) -> not Hub-reusable without permission.

assets.title: LIRA-AI: Landscape Intelligence for Regeneration and Adaptation
assets.description: Prototype multi-agent AI platform for investable landscape regeneration: 14 specialist agents diagnose land degradation (syndromes, indicators, causal graphs), project climate futures (NASA NEX GDDP CMIP6), generate restoration pathways, screen GCF/LDCF/AF investment and run RAG over CGIAR CGSpace, exposed via a Next.js dashboard and an MCP server of 10 scientific tools. Piloted on the Omo-Ghibe Basin, Ethiopia.

assets.title: A satellite foundation model for improved wealth monitoring
assets.description: Preprint introducing a satellite foundation model self-supervised on ~3 million bi-temporal Landsat image pairs and adapted with parameter-efficient fine-tuning to sparse survey labels, to predict economic livelihoods and wealth at scale where censuses and household surveys are costly, infrequent or outdated - aimed at improving poverty and wealth monitoring in low- and middle-income countries.
assets.notes: arXiv 2604.23166 (preprint, 2026). Authors: Zhuo Zheng, Ivan Higuera-Mendieta, Richard Lee, David Newhouse, Talip Kilic, Stefano Ermon, Marshall Burke, David B. Lobell (Stanford + World Bank). Licence not confirmed (arXiv default) - reuse status TBC.

assets.title: Climate Risk Commons (Open Climate Risk Framework)
assets.description: An open standard and platform for physical climate financial risk. The Open Climate Risk Framework (OCRF) defines shared schemas, APIs and SDKs so hazard data, physical assets and impact/damage functions interoperate; the Ecofusion reference pipeline runs the whole spec end-to-end on open reference data. Covers 50+ hazards, 193 countries, all IPCC scenarios and 15 horizons to 2100, and is among the first production systems built on CMIP7. Open components are Apache-2.0; high-fidelity data is commercial.
assets.notes: Not-for-profit founded/funded by RiskThinking.AI (Toronto); CEO/founder Dr. Ron Dembo. Membership free for non-commercial research (request access). Built on CMIP7. Contacts: academic@ / opensource@riskthinking.ai.
assets.data_availability: Open standard, reference pipeline & reference data (Apache-2.0); high-fidelity data commercial

assets.title: Quasi-global, land-only, high-resolution downscaled CMIP6 climate variables for climate impact research
assets.description: Bias-corrected, downscaled CMIP6 climate outputs at 0.1 degree daily resolution for 1985-2100 (DBCCA method), covering 12 land-only domains between 60N and 60S from six CMIP6 models under SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5, plus user-ready population-weighted variables aggregated to administrative units (levels 0-2) for 110 countries prioritised for tropical health/disease impact research. NetCDF + Parquet, hosted via Box.
assets.notes: Jahn, Gaythorpe, Dorigatti, Winskill, Hinsley, Wainwright, Toumi, Ferguson (Imperial College London; Univ. Leeds). Funded by Wellcome Trust & Gates Foundation. Descriptor preprint under review at Scientific Data (Research Square rs-9508034).
assets.data_availability: Open data (Zenodo record + Box; NetCDF & Parquet)

assets.title: FEWS NET Data Explorer (FDW)
assets.description: Interactive data explorer for the FEWS NET Data Warehouse (FDW) - the Famine Early Warning Systems Network's food-security data: staple food and livestock market prices, crop and livestock production, and acute food-insecurity (IPC-compatible) classifications, visualised for early warning across food-insecure regions.
assets.region: Africa, Latin America, Middle East & Asia (FEWS NET)
assets.notes: FEWS NET is USAID-funded. Distinct from the USGS FEWS software tools already listed. Data broadly public (US Government); confirm per-series licensing before ingest.

assets.title: ESGF MetaGrid (East index)
assets.description: Faceted search portal (MetaGrid) for the ESGF East index, the CEDA-hosted route into federated climate model output — currently CMIP7 and CORDEX-CMIP6, filterable by MIP era, activity, institution, model, experiment, variant, table, variable and grid label. Files are retrievable by HTTP download, wget script, OPeNDAP or Globus transfer; searching and HTTP download need no account, while Globus transfers, saved searches and a persistent data cart require sign-in.
assets.notes: The East-index search recommended in the WCRP CMIP7 guidance for data users. ESGF is mid-migration to its next-generation index and the East and West indexes are not mirrored — the West MetaGrid was not carrying CMIP7 / CORDEX-CMIP6 as of September 2026, so search both. MetaGrid replaces the retired CoG front end. Licence is per dataset (each dataset carries a licence global attribute), so no portal-level licence is recorded and reusable is left false; check the individual dataset licence before any Hub ingest, and acknowledge CMIP7 contributors and ESGF in publications.
organisations: Centre for Environmental Data Analysis (CEDA / STFC)

assets.title: Fields of The World (FTW)
assets.description: Open ecosystem for delineating agricultural field boundaries from satellite imagery: a benchmark dataset of ~1.6 million labelled parcels across 70,000+ multi-date Sentinel-2 samples (24 countries at publication, since extended), plus baseline and PRUE segmentation models, an inference API, a QGIS plugin and web apps that run and polygonise predictions. The data-products strand — country-wide inferred field maps published as GeoParquet or GeoJSON — is in development for Kenya, Vietnam, Laos and Colombia, with no full-country release shipped yet.
assets.notes: Logged from the ecosystem page's data-products section: country-scale field maps are still in development, so what is usable today is the benchmark dataset, the models and the tooling. Licensing is not uniform — code is MIT (ftw-baselines) or Apache-2.0 (inference API, web and editing apps, QGIS plugin), while the benchmark aggregates national datasets under mixed terms: CC-BY-4.0 (Austria, Brazil, Cambodia, Finland, India, Rwanda, Spain, Vietnam), CC0-1.0 (Denmark, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Slovakia), CC-BY-NC-4.0 (Latvia, Portugal), CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 (South Africa), DL-DE/BY-2.0 (Germany) and GPL-2.0-or-later (Kenya). The CC-BY-SA-4.0 shown on the website covers the site itself, not the data. Because non-commercial components are included, no single licence is recorded and reusable is left false — assess reuse per source country before any Hub ingest; the Kenya subset is copyleft.
organisations: Microsoft AI for Good Research Lab

assets.title: open-climate.ai — open emission factor library & matching agent
assets.description: Search, export and API access over roughly 275,000 greenhouse-gas emission factor values harmonised from 33 public publisher libraries — including ADEME/AGRIBALYSE, EXIOBASE, US EPA, USEEIO, DESNZ, MITECO and ÖKOBAUDAT — onto a single data model that carries each factor's licence, attribution text and provenance. A reasoning-based matching agent maps free-text procurement or spend lines to GHG-Protocol-compliant factors, exposed through the web app, a read API and an MCP endpoint.
assets.notes: For agrifood work the relevant libraries are mainly AGRIBALYSE (French food LCA) and EXIOBASE; publisher coverage skews to the EU, UK and US. Licensing is tiered per library release — open (public domain or attribution-only, redistribution granted), copyleft (share-alike, e.g. EXIOBASE and Open CEDA under CC-BY-SA-4.0), restricted (factor descriptions served with values withheld) and prohibited (not served at all) — so nothing served carries a non-commercial restriction. open-climate.ai's own harmonisation layer is CC-BY-4.0, becoming CC-BY-SA-4.0 where it adapts a copyleft library; reuse must credit the original publisher first and then open-climate.ai, as a working hyperlink on web use. Factor search and file matching need no account, but bulk library downloads need a free account and the versioned API needs a key, which is why access is recorded as login. No operating company or legal entity is named on the site or in the docs, so no organisation or contact is recorded.

assets.title: FAO Livestock Hub
assets.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
assets.description: FAO's single gateway to its livestock data, analytical tools and knowledge, launched in September 2026 at the 2nd Global Conference on Sustainable Livestock Transformation. Dashboards organised by theme and geography cover livestock production, animal health risks and antimicrobial resistance, climate and environmental interactions — including GLEAM greenhouse-gas estimates for animal populations, products, emissions and emission intensities — alongside economic and social indicators, with a Livestock AI Assistant for navigating across them.
assets.notes: An aggregator rather than a single dataset. The GLEAM dashboard reached through it serves animal population, animal products, emissions and emission intensities, with input and emission-intensity data downloadable under CC-BY-4.0 together with FAO's Statistical Database Terms of Use; other dashboards carry their own terms, so no portal-level licence is recorded and reusable is left false — check the specific dashboard before ingest. The GLEAM model implementation is catalogued separately as the GLEAM R package.

assets.title: EX-ACT — Environmental eXternalities ACcounting Tool (web app codebase)
assets.source: FAO — Agrifood Economics and Policy Division (ESA)
assets.description: Source code for FAO's EX-ACT online application, which appraises the greenhouse-gas balance of agrifood-system interventions: CO2, CH4, N2O and refrigerants across land-use change, biomass and soil carbon stocks, crop, grassland and rice management, fertiliser and residue handling, livestock (enteric fermentation, manure, feed) and downstream value-chain steps such as processing, refrigeration, transport and packaging. Emission factors come from the IPCC National GHG Inventory Guidelines (2006, 2014 wetlands supplement, 2019 refinement), applied as Tier 1 defaults or Tier 2 where local parameters exist, with baseline and intervention scenarios aggregated into a net project carbon balance.
assets.notes: Codebase behind the hosted EX-ACT app; the published technical guidelines (version 9, 2022) still document the underlying method. Python 3.11 / Django 5.2, in active development since August 2024, copyright FAO 2023-2026, developed with contributions from IFAD. AGPL-3.0-or-later is network copyleft — deploying a modified instance obliges publishing the modified source, which matters if the Hub ever hosts its own copy. Contact is the team address published in the repository, not an individual.

assets.title: Dataset of the suitability of major food crops in Africa under climate change
assets.description: Data descriptor for a continental dataset of climate suitability for 23 major African food crops, generated with a calibrated EcoCrop model driven by ISIMIP3b temperature and precipitation and ISRIC soil data. Covers a historical baseline and mid-century projections under SSP1-RCP2.6, SSP3-RCP7.0 and SSP5-RCP8.5, giving both a continuous suitability index and a binary suitable/unsuitable class per crop for rainfed agriculture.
assets.spatial_resolution: 0.5 degrees (ISIMIP3b climate grid; soil resampled to match)
assets.temporal_coverage: Historical baseline and 2050 projections (10-GCM mean) under three SSP-RCP scenarios
assets.notes: The 23 crops are eight cereals (maize, sorghum, pearl millet, finger millet, wheat, rice, teff, fonio), six legumes and pulses (cowpea, peanut, bambara nut, common bean, soybean, chickpea), six root and tuber crops (cassava, cocoyam, sweet potato, white yam, potato, tannia) and three banana-family crops (highland bananas, plantains, enset). Data are archived as a Springer Nature figshare collection and the R code is on GitHub; the article itself is open access despite the Nature domain. Suitability is modelled for rainfed production and takes no account of land availability, so suitable area includes protected, urban and otherwise unavailable land - the authors flag this as a usage limit.
organisations: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK)

assets.title: GeoAquaCrop
assets.description: Python toolchain for running the FAO AquaCrop crop-water-productivity model (via AquaCrop-OSPy) over large regions on a grid, presented as three stages behind one import: preprocess, simulate and visualize. Given a polygon and a period it downloads and harmonises climate, soil, crop-calendar and crop-area data onto a common grid, runs AquaCrop per cell in parallel with optional yield bias-correction and calibration against observations, and serves the outputs through a Dash dashboard.
assets.spatial_resolution: User-defined output grid; inputs AgERA5 0.1 deg, NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 0.25 deg, SoilGrids 250 m, GGCMI calendars 0.5 deg, SPAM ~10 km
assets.temporal_coverage: Past 1979 to last complete year (AgERA5); future years via NEX-GDDP-CMIP6
assets.notes: Input sources are chosen automatically: AgERA5 reanalysis for past climate (needs a free Copernicus CDS account and API token), NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 for future or pre-1979 years, ISRIC SoilGrids for texture and organic matter, GGCMI phase 3 crop calendars and SPAM 2010/2020 crop areas. Outputs are compressed NetCDF on a shared grid. The three stages are separately installable packages (geoaquacrop_preprocess, _simulate, _visualize) with the same function names. New in September 2026 and under active development; a preprint is forthcoming, and the repository asks that work citing it also cite AquaCrop-OSPy. Attribution per the repository: Lang-Ritter, Bowden, Hosseini, Alkio, Tenkanen and Foster.
